command:
git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'MSG'
APRV-402: state the write roots as agreement, not as a list of temp directories

CI's shard 3 failed one assertion of the new suite and the pass was right:
the suite builds its world under os.tmpdir(), which IS /tmp on a Linux
runner, so resolveScratchRoots discards /tmp for containing the working
directory, its own guard and the correct one, and the surviving temp root is
/var/tmp. The assertion listed the macOS names.

It now asserts what has to hold everywhere: resolveWriteRoots(cwd) is
[cwd, ...resolveScratchRoots(cwd)], so the write rule and the delete rule
cannot disagree about where the agent's scratch is. Verified 10/10 under the
ordinary layout and 10/10 with TMPDIR=/tmp, which reproduces the runner.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
MSG
git push 2>&1 | tail -2
